page_title: LEV 2-1 AUG | Bayer Leverkusen v Augsburg 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+1' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Arne Maier is replaced by Mahmut Kucuksahin (Augsburg).
90+1' Substitution. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) on for Ermedin Demirovic.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
90' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

88' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Tomas Koubek makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) heads on.
84' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
82' Jeremie Frimpong comes off the pitch to be replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg).
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
81' Great save! Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Lukas Hradecky.
79' Lovely run from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
78' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Jeremie Frimpong, who fails to shoot.
76' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
74' Here is a change. Phillip Tietz is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Sven Michel (Augsburg).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mert Komur trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pep Biel (Augsburg).
74' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

74' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Tomas Koubek pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar.
72' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Tomas Koubek.
71' The resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Alejandro Grimaldo can be given a rest.
70' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Exequiel Palacios.
69' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
67' Arne Maier (Augsburg) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ermedin Demirovic.
66' CHANCE! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
65' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
62' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Victor Boniface will be replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
62' It will be a substitution. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to enter the pitch as Amine Adli walks off.
62' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Mert Komur (Augsburg) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the right post. Arne Maier provided an assist for the goal.
61' PENALTY APPEAL by Augsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
61' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

60' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' Arne Engels (Augsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul after Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) hacks down one of his opponents. Augsburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
56' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
55' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
54' Augsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' Bayer Leverkusen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Tomas Koubek, who makes a comfortable save.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
45+1' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+1' Arne Maier (Augsburg) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
42' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
41' Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) is being substituted because of an injury. Jess Thorup sends Arne Engels on the pitch.
38' The game is interrupted now, Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Mert Komur (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
29' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
27' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is first to the rebound and finds the back of the net with a brilliant back-heel finish.
27' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
27' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
25' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Tomas Koubek is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
22' It seemed like Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
20' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
18' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
17' Mert Komur (Augsburg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
16' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Tomas Koubek.
13' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Tomas Koubek makes a huge mistake and Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
11' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
10' Flag up against Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
8' A pass into the penalty area from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
6' A player from Augsburg pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
5' The ball is out of play. Augsburg will take a throw-in.
3' A lofted cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
3' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
